answer:
The Roman emperor who famously declared war on the sea was **Caligula** (reigned 37–41 CE).  
He was preceded by **Tiberius**, who ruled from 14 CE to 37 CE. Thus, the emperor before the one who declared war on the sea was **Tiberius**.
